capabilities: Display property dates and times in a custom format
Type and paste dates in the user's format and save standard values
Pick from preset date formats or enter any Moment.js format
Reject invalid dates with a red underline and restore the old value
Work in the Properties panel and in Bases table cells
extras: The plugin relies on undocumented CSS classes of Obsidian's property editor, so an Obsidian update could break it; it has not been tested on mobile.
intentEvidence: Obsidian shows dates in Properties the way your operating system's language says.
motivation: The author built it because the forum request for a date format setting has been open since 2023 and there is no built-in option.
problem: Obsidian formats property dates and times according to the system language, with no setting to change the display format.
summary: Property editor tweak that displays and accepts date/time values in Properties and Bases in a user-chosen format while notes keep standard values.
